title: Present perfect and past simple -  6 Minute Grammar
speaker: BBC Learning English
zh: 【BBC Learning English】現在完成式和一般過去式 - 6 分鐘語法（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: six-minute grammar from bbclearningenglish.com
cues.en: six-minute grammar from bbclearningenglish.com
cues.zh: 來自 bbclearningenglish.com 的六分鐘語法

cues.text: Hello and welcome to six-minute grammar with me, Catherine.
cues.en: Hello and welcome to six-minute grammar with me, Catherine.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎和我一起學習六分鐘文法，凱瑟琳。

cues.text: And me, Neil. Hello.
cues.en: And me, Neil. Hello.
cues.zh: 還有我，尼爾。你好。

cues.text: Today we're talking about the present perfect and the past simple tenses.
cues.en: Today we're talking about the present perfect and the past simple tenses.
cues.zh: 今天我們討論現在完成式和過去簡單式。

cues.text: Yes, we're going to tell you how to form them and give you three rules
cues.en: Yes, we're going to tell you how to form them and give you three rules
cues.zh: 是的，我們將告訴您如何形成它們並給您三個規則

cues.text: to help you decide which one to use and when.
cues.en: to help you decide which one to use and when.
cues.zh: 幫助您決定使用哪一種以及何時使用。

cues.text: We'll also look at using ever and never with the present perfect.
cues.en: We'll also look at using ever and never with the present perfect.
cues.zh: 我們還將考慮使用ever和never與現在完成式一起使用。

cues.text: And we'll finish with a quiz.
cues.en: And we'll finish with a quiz.
cues.zh: 最後我們將進行一個測驗。

cues.text: Right then, let's start with the present perfect and here's our first example.
cues.en: Right then, let's start with the present perfect and here's our first example.
cues.zh: 那麼，讓我們從現在完成式開始，這是我們的第一個例子。

cues.text: I've looked at the cells figures. They've shot up by 20%.
cues.en: I've looked at the cells figures. They've shot up by 20%.
cues.zh: 我看過細胞資料。他們的股價上漲了 20%。

cues.text: So it's subject plus have or has plus a past participle.
cues.en: So it's subject plus have or has plus a past participle.
cues.zh: 所以它的主詞加上have或has加上過去分詞。

cues.text: To make past participles of regular verbs, add ed to the main verb.
cues.en: To make past participles of regular verbs, add ed to the main verb.
cues.zh: 要製作規則動詞的過去分詞，請在主要動詞後面加上 ed。

cues.text: So look becomes looked.
cues.en: So look becomes looked.
cues.zh: 所以看起來就變成看起來了。

cues.text: But some verbs like shoot are irregular.
cues.en: But some verbs like shoot are irregular.
cues.zh: 但有些動詞如shoot是不規則的。

cues.text: The past participle of shoot is shot.
cues.en: The past participle of shoot is shot.
cues.zh: shot的過去分詞是shot。

cues.text: You just have to learn your irregular verbs.
cues.en: You just have to learn your irregular verbs.
cues.zh: 你只需要學習不規則動詞。

cues.text: That's right and we often use short forms in the present perfect like I've,
cues.en: That's right and we often use short forms in the present perfect like I've,
cues.zh: 是的，我們經常像我一樣使用現在完成式的縮寫形式，

cues.text: he's and they've.
cues.en: he's and they've.
cues.zh: 他是，他們也是。

cues.text: Now, here's an example of the past simple.
cues.en: Now, here's an example of the past simple.
cues.zh: 現在，這是一個簡單過去式的例子。

cues.text: I looked at the cells figures this morning.
cues.en: I looked at the cells figures this morning.
cues.zh: 今天早上我看了細胞資料。

cues.text: They shot up by 20% last month.
cues.en: They shot up by 20% last month.
cues.zh: 上個月它們飆升了 20%。

cues.text: For the past simple of regular verbs, add ed to the main verb.
cues.en: For the past simple of regular verbs, add ed to the main verb.
cues.zh: 對於規則動詞的過去簡單形式，在主要動詞後面加上 ed。

cues.text: So look becomes looked.
cues.en: So look becomes looked.
cues.zh: 所以看起來就變成看起來了。

cues.text: But don't forget those irregular verbs.
cues.en: But don't forget those irregular verbs.
cues.zh: 但不要忘記那些不規則動詞。

cues.text: The past simple of go is went.
cues.en: The past simple of go is went.
cues.zh: go 的過去簡單形式是 gone。

cues.text: Now, it's often difficult to know which tense to use.
cues.en: Now, it's often difficult to know which tense to use.
cues.zh: 現在，通常很難知道該使用哪種時態。

cues.text: It can be.
cues.en: It can be.
cues.zh: 可以的。

cues.text: So we've got some rules for you.
cues.en: So we've got some rules for you.
cues.zh: 所以我們為您制定了一些規則。

cues.text: Listen to the first example again.
cues.en: Listen to the first example again.
cues.zh: 再聽一遍第一個例子。

cues.text: I've looked at the cells figures.
cues.en: I've looked at the cells figures.
cues.zh: 我看過細胞資料。

cues.text: They've shot up by 20%.
cues.en: They've shot up by 20%.
cues.zh: 他們的股價上漲了 20%。

cues.text: And it's present perfect here because we're focusing on what happened, not when.
cues.en: And it's present perfect here because we're focusing on what happened, not when.
cues.zh: 它在這裡是完美的，因為我們關注的是發生的事情，而不是時間。

cues.text: But in the second example...
cues.en: But in the second example...
cues.zh: 但在第二個例子中...

cues.text: I looked at the cells figures this morning.
cues.en: I looked at the cells figures this morning.
cues.zh: 今天早上我看了細胞資料。

cues.text: They shot up by 20% last month.
cues.en: They shot up by 20% last month.
cues.zh: 上個月它們飆升了 20%。

cues.text: It's the past simple because we say when the actions happened.
cues.en: It's the past simple because we say when the actions happened.
cues.zh: 這是簡單過去式，因為我們說的是動作發生的時間。

cues.text: So that's rule one.
cues.en: So that's rule one.
cues.zh: 這就是第一條規則。

cues.text: Use the present perfect to say what happened,
cues.en: Use the present perfect to say what happened,
cues.zh: 用現在完成式說出發生了什麼，

cues.text: but the past simple for when or where something happened.
cues.en: but the past simple for when or where something happened.
cues.zh: 但一般過去式表示某事發生的時間或地點。

cues.text: Now, Neil, just a minute, because I actually...
cues.en: Now, Neil, just a minute, because I actually...
cues.zh: 現在，尼爾，請等一下，因為我實際上...

cues.text: I haven't eaten this morning.
cues.en: I haven't eaten this morning.
cues.zh: 我今天早上還沒吃飯。

cues.text: And that's an example of the present perfect with a time phrase.
cues.en: And that's an example of the present perfect with a time phrase.
cues.zh: 這是現在完成式與時間短語的範例。

cues.text: So sometimes we can use the present perfect to say when something happened,
cues.en: So sometimes we can use the present perfect to say when something happened,
cues.zh: 所以有時我們可以用現在完成式來表示某事發生時，

cues.text: when a situation started in the past and is still true or still happening now.
cues.en: when a situation started in the past and is still true or still happening now.
cues.zh: 當某種情況從過去開始並且現在仍然存在或仍在發生時。

cues.text: Here's a biscuit, Catherine, because you haven't eaten anything this morning.
cues.en: Here's a biscuit, Catherine, because you haven't eaten anything this morning.
cues.zh: 這是一塊餅乾，凱瑟琳，因為你今天早上沒有吃任何東西。

cues.text: I haven't.
cues.en: I haven't.
cues.zh: 我沒有。

cues.text: But if I said I didn't eat anything this morning with the past simple,
cues.en: But if I said I didn't eat anything this morning with the past simple,
cues.zh: 但如果我用一般過去式說我今天早上沒吃任何東西

cues.text: it would mean it isn't morning anymore.
cues.en: it would mean it isn't morning anymore.
cues.zh: 這意味著現在已經不是早上了。

cues.text: Now it's the afternoon or the evening.
cues.en: Now it's the afternoon or the evening.
cues.zh: 現在是下午或晚上。

cues.text: Yes, the action started and finished in the past.
cues.en: Yes, the action started and finished in the past.
cues.zh: 是的，動作在過去開始和結束。

cues.text: You must be starving.
cues.en: You must be starving.
cues.zh: 你一定是餓壞了。

cues.text: Go on.
cues.en: Go on.
cues.zh: 繼續。

cues.text: Here you go. Have another biscuit.
cues.en: Here you go. Have another biscuit.
cues.zh: 幹得好。再吃一塊餅乾。

cues.text: Thank you very much.
cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感謝。

cues.text: So that's rule two.
cues.en: So that's rule two.
cues.zh: 這就是第二條規則。

cues.text: Use the present perfect for events that started in the past and are continuing now.
cues.en: Use the present perfect for events that started in the past and are continuing now.
cues.zh: 對過去開始且現在仍在繼續的事件使用現在完成式。

cues.text: And the past simple for actions that started and finished in the past.
cues.en: And the past simple for actions that started and finished in the past.
cues.zh: 簡單過去式表示過去開始和結束的動作。

cues.text: Nice biscuits, Neil.
cues.en: Nice biscuits, Neil.
cues.zh: 不錯的餅乾，尼爾。

cues.text: And we're talking about when to use the present perfect and the past simple.
cues.en: And we're talking about when to use the present perfect and the past simple.
cues.zh: 我們正在討論何時使用現在完成式和一般過去式。

cues.text: Now, we often use the present perfect with ever and never for life experiences,
cues.en: Now, we often use the present perfect with ever and never for life experiences,
cues.zh: 現在，我們經常將現在完成式與ever和never一起用於生活經歷，

cues.text: things we've done at some point in the past.
cues.en: things we've done at some point in the past.
cues.zh: 我們過去某個時刻做過的事。

cues.text: Here's a question for you, Catherine.
cues.en: Here's a question for you, Catherine.
cues.zh: 這是要問你的問題，凱瑟琳。

cues.text: Have you ever eaten insects?
cues.en: Have you ever eaten insects?
cues.zh: 你吃過昆蟲嗎？

cues.text: Funnily enough, Neil, no.
cues.en: Funnily enough, Neil, no.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，尼爾，不。

cues.text: I've never eaten an insect
cues.en: I've never eaten an insect
cues.zh: 我從來沒有吃過昆蟲

cues.text: and I don't think I ever will.
cues.en: and I don't think I ever will.
cues.zh: 我想我永遠不會。

cues.text: How about you?
cues.en: How about you?
cues.zh: 你呢？

cues.text: Oh yes, actually I have eaten insects.
cues.en: Oh yes, actually I have eaten insects.
cues.zh: 哦，是的，其實我吃過昆蟲。

cues.text: Yes, I've eaten ants that were given to me by a friend from Colombia.
cues.en: Yes, I've eaten ants that were given to me by a friend from Colombia.
cues.zh: 是的，我吃過哥倫比亞朋友送給我的螞蟻。

cues.text: Very good.
cues.en: Very good.
cues.zh: 非常好。

cues.text: So, rule three.
cues.en: So, rule three.
cues.zh: 所以，規則三。

cues.text: Use ever with the present perfect to ask about a past experience
cues.en: Use ever with the present perfect to ask about a past experience
cues.zh: 與現在完成式一起使用來詢問過去的經歷

cues.text: and never to talk about an experience you haven't had.
cues.en: and never to talk about an experience you haven't had.
cues.zh: 並且永遠不要談論你沒有經歷過的經歷。

cues.text: But if you add information about time and place,
cues.en: But if you add information about time and place,
cues.zh: 但如果加上時間地點的訊息

cues.text: use the past simple.
cues.en: use the past simple.
cues.zh: 使用一般過去式。

cues.text: I ate insects last summer in Colombia.
cues.en: I ate insects last summer in Colombia.
cues.zh: 去年夏天我在哥倫比亞吃過昆蟲。

cues.text: And Neil used present perfect in I have eaten insects
cues.en: And Neil used present perfect in I have eaten insects
cues.zh: 尼爾在《我吃過昆蟲》中使用了現在完成式

cues.text: because he was focusing on the event itself, not when it happened.
cues.en: because he was focusing on the event itself, not when it happened.
cues.zh: 因為他關注的是事件本身，而不是事情發生的時間。

cues.text: Well, actually I wasn't focusing on anything.
cues.en: Well, actually I wasn't focusing on anything.
cues.zh: 好吧，實際上我並沒有專注於任何事情。

cues.text: I kept my eyes shut the whole time.
cues.en: I kept my eyes shut the whole time.
cues.zh: 我自始至終都閉著眼睛。

cues.text: They didn't look very nice.
cues.en: They didn't look very nice.
cues.zh: 他們看起來不太好。

cues.text: Right, but they tasted all right.
cues.en: Right, but they tasted all right.
cues.zh: 是的，但味道還不錯。

cues.text: They tasted OK, yeah.
cues.en: They tasted OK, yeah.
cues.zh: 他們嘗起來還不錯，是的。

cues.text: Good.
cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.text: It's now time for a quiz.
cues.en: It's now time for a quiz.
cues.zh: 現在是測驗時間。

cues.text: Which is correct?
cues.en: Which is correct?
cues.zh: 哪個才是正確的？

cues.text: Number one.
cues.en: Number one.
cues.zh: 第一。

cues.text: I've been for a job interview last week.
cues.en: I've been for a job interview last week.
cues.zh: 我上週去參加了一次工作面試。

cues.text: I went for a job interview last week.
cues.en: I went for a job interview last week.
cues.zh: 上週我去參加了一次工作面試。

cues.text: And it's B.
cues.en: And it's B.
cues.zh: 而且是B。

cues.text: I went for a job interview last week.
cues.en: I went for a job interview last week.
cues.zh: 上週我去參加了一次工作面試。

cues.text: Use the past simple when you say when something happened.
cues.en: Use the past simple when you say when something happened.
cues.zh: 當你說某件事發生時，使用簡單過去式。

cues.text: Number two.
cues.en: Number two.
cues.zh: 第二。

cues.text: I never went for a job interview.
cues.en: I never went for a job interview.
cues.zh: 我從未參加過工作面試。

cues.text: I have never been for a job interview.
cues.en: I have never been for a job interview.
cues.zh: 我從未參加過工作面試。

cues.text: And it's B.
cues.en: And it's B.
cues.zh: 而且是B。

cues.text: I have never been for a job interview.
cues.en: I have never been for a job interview.
cues.zh: 我從未參加過工作面試。

cues.text: We use the present perfect with never.
cues.en: We use the present perfect with never.
cues.zh: 我們將現在完成式與 never 一起使用。

cues.text: And the last one.
cues.en: And the last one.
cues.zh: 還有最後一張。

cues.text: A. Who has eaten all my biscuits?
cues.en: A. Who has eaten all my biscuits?
cues.zh: A. 誰吃了我所有的餅乾？

cues.text: Or B. Who ate all my biscuits?
cues.en: Or B. Who ate all my biscuits?
cues.zh: 或 B. 誰吃了我所有的餅乾？

cues.text: And that's a trick question because actually both are correct.
cues.en: And that's a trick question because actually both are correct.
cues.zh: 這是一個棘手的問題，因為實際上兩者都是正確的。

cues.text: And by the way, Neil, it wasn't me.
cues.en: And by the way, Neil, it wasn't me.
cues.zh: 順便說一句，尼爾，那不是我。

cues.text: I didn't eat all your biscuits.
cues.en: I didn't eat all your biscuits.
cues.zh: 我沒有吃完你的餅乾。

cues.text: Yeah, I'm sure.
cues.en: Yeah, I'm sure.
cues.zh: 是的，我確定。

cues.text: That means we have now come to the end of our programme.
cues.en: That means we have now come to the end of our programme.
cues.zh: 這意味著我們的計劃現在已經結束。

cues.text: There's more about this on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.
cues.en: There's more about this on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.
cues.zh: 我們的網站 bbclearningenglish.com 上有更多相關資訊。

cues.text: Join us again for more 6 Minute Grammar.
cues.en: Join us again for more 6 Minute Grammar.
cues.zh: 再次加入我們，瞭解更多 6 分鐘文法。

cues.text: bbclearningenglish.com
cues.en: bbclearningenglish.com
